capability.title: Agent Estate and Governance Reconciliation
capability.outcome: Agent names, maturity, permissions and ownership match actual code and runtime evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Every product-facing agent has one responsibility and evidence level.
validation: Governance registry checks and representative runtime evidence.

stories.title: Reconcile Agent Catalog Against Current Code
stories.outcome: Old stub/open classifications are checked against wrappers, aliases, tests and runtime evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Each stale row is resolved, retained with evidence gap, or archived.
validation: Static inventory plus sampled code/test/runtime review.

stories.title: Classify Compatibility Wrappers and Aliases
stories.outcome: Compatibility entry points are not mistaken for duplicate product agents or stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Docs and diagrams show canonical implementation only.

stories.title: Routing and Orchestrator Ownership Consolidation
stories.outcome: Queue routing, chain orchestration, stop reassessment and nightly scheduling do not compete for next-action authority.
acceptance_criteria: One authoritative routing contract and explicit handoffs.

stories.title: Agent Write-Boundary Audit
stories.outcome: All write-capable agents expose consistent read-only/dry-run/apply/approval semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive agents have permission and side-effect matrix.
Inconsistent CLIs become explicit work items.
validation: Static CLI/code audit and targeted boundary tests.

stories.title: Learning-Output Boundary Contract
stories.outcome: Vocabulary, search-term, observation and recommendation outputs cannot silently become gate truth.
acceptance_criteria: Allowed consumers and promotion gate defined for each learning output.

stories.title: Product-Agent Maturity Evidence Refresh
stories.outcome: Product-facing agents receive current L0-L5 or capability status backed by tests and runtime evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No product-trusted claim below audited threshold.
